description: Count customer-initiated debits in a 24-hour window anchored at the first debit of a burst; fires when the count reaches the threshold.
applies_to: DEBIT transactions of type PURCHASE, ATM_WITHDRAWAL, BILL_PAYMENT, TRANSFER_OUT

description: Sum the debits made through a device within 48 hours of the device's first use on the account; only devices first linked at least 7 days after account opening count as new.
applies_to: DEBIT transactions with a device_id (digital channels)
metric_name: EUR debited via new device within 48h

description: Follow transfer links forward in time from each transfer; fires when funds return to the originating account through at least 3 distinct accounts within 72 hours, every hop within +/-10% of the first hop amount.
After a DORMANT->ACTIVE status event, sum the customer-initiated debits of the next 7 days; fires when the sum reaches the threshold.
applies_to: account_status_history DORMANT->ACTIVE events and the account's DEBIT transactions
metric_name: EUR debited within 7 days of reactivation

description: Divide a single card, cash or bill-payment debit by the customer's KYC expected_max_txn_amount; fires when the ratio reaches the threshold.
applies_to: DEBIT transactions of type PURCHASE, ATM_WITHDRAWAL, BILL_PAYMENT
